title: The British Museum
description: Explore world history and culture, including the Rosetta Stone, Egyptian mummies and ancient artefacts.

title: Natural History Museum
description: Discover dinosaurs, fossils, wildlife and the natural history of our planet.

title: Science Museum
description: Explore science, technology, space exploration, engineering and interactive exhibitions.

title: Victoria and Albert Museum
description: Discover art, fashion, sculpture, photography, jewellery and design from around the world.

title: Tate Modern
description: A major modern and contemporary art museum in a former power station on the River Thames.

title: Tate Britain
description: Explore British art from the 1500s to the present day, including works by J.M.W. Turner.

title: National Gallery
description: Discover European paintings from the 13th to the early 20th century in Trafalgar Square.

title: Imperial War Museum London
description: Learn about modern conflict and its impact on people through military artefacts, exhibitions and personal stories.

title: National Maritime Museum
description: Explore Britain's maritime history, naval discoveries and the story of exploration at Greenwich.

title: Royal Observatory Greenwich
description: Discover astronomy, historic telescopes and the Prime Meridian, where longitude is measured.

title: Horniman Museum and Gardens
description: Explore natural history, anthropology, musical instruments and extensive landscaped gardens.
cost: Free; some exhibitions and activities may cost extra

title: Design Museum
description: Discover contemporary design, architecture, fashion, graphics and product innovation.
cost: Free entry to permanent displays; special exhibitions may be paid

title: Museum of London Docklands
description: Discover the history of London's docks, the River Thames, trade and the development of the city.

title: Wallace Collection
description: Explore European paintings, armour, furniture, porcelain and decorative arts in a historic townhouse.

title: Sir John Soane's Museum
description: Visit the former home of architect John Soane, filled with antiquities, paintings and architectural models.

title: Charles Dickens Museum
description: Explore the former home of Charles Dickens and discover objects and stories from his life and work.

title: London Transport Museum
description: Discover the history of London's buses, Underground trains, taxis and public transport network.

title: Bank of England Museum
description: Learn about the history of the Bank of England, British money, banking and monetary policy.

title: Museum of the Home
description: Explore how homes and domestic life in England have changed over the centuries.

title: Royal Air Force Museum London
description: Discover aviation history and military aircraft through historic planes and interactive displays.
